notes.title: Sandara Soundtrack Release!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZcNmPZbthf8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187920/Sandara_Soundtrack/]The original soundtrack[/url] of Sandara has now been released![/h3]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/aasma.mp3/]Mira Aasma[/url] has composed a unique album specifically for Sandara. As the game's composer, she has crafted an original soundtrack that immerses you deeper into the world of Sandara.

➡️[url=https://youtu.be/j8ukdi_DLFA?si=-Oz6BJZN5aDTihyY&t=2108][b]Take me to the live show from Save & Sound 2024[/b][/url]⬅️

There are plenty more games from the Save & Sound Festival to discover - explore the incredible talent of this year's music and sound designers at the festival!

[h3]Buy the album and listen to the OST now:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187920/Sandara_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Collect cards to create synergies!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050443/3e2cc48d4f77199cda48dc76d393aa9586cecc40.png[/img]
After some workshopping, we have arrived at what we believe is the most enjoyable part of a deck-builder: creating synergies between cards! 

In the new design, you as the player will be able to collect cards that create beneficial synergies between them. We are looking forward to having you playtest the beta and provide us with your feedback.

What do you look forward to in the beta testing?🌞

[h3]Join closed beta[/h3]
Help us improve Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipses by joining our closed playtest. Use the [url=https://subscribepage.io/D4A7QO]link[/url] to visit the landing page of Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipses and enter your email to be considered for the beta in future invitation rounds.

notes.title: Trailer Launch at Future of Play Direct
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WXAMhQmRa_I;full][/previewyoutube]
We're beyond thrilled to be a part of this great showcase alongside so many incredible games. We hope you'll check out all the showcase has to offer, including our own game, [b]Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipses[/b], whose trailer will be premiered during the event.

[h3]Future of Play Direct[/h3]
Make sure you tune into the Future of Play Direct tomorrow on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WXAMhQmRa_I]YouTube[/url] on the 8th of June at 9:00am PT 6:00pm CEST / 12:00pm ET.

[h3]Steam Event[/h3]
Visit the Steam event [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futureofplay]here[/url] and browse the full catalogue of games from season 5 collection, harmless fun for the whole family, builds and cultivate sustainably, for the girls, gays and theys, doing crime without the time and more.
